The largest bone in the human body is the femur, also known as the thigh bone.

Regarding the physical therapy technique described in the evidence, myofascial release therapy appears to be an effective intervention for myofascial pain syndrome. By applying gentle, sustained pressure to the fascial connective tissues, the technique aims to alleviate restrictions in motion and reduce pain. This approach is particularly useful for treating sensitive trigger points within the muscles, which can help improve the patient's range of motion and overall comfort.
